working_tree: Uncommitted WP2.2 implementation; binary compiled once before all metadata runs.
host_reference: Apple M5 / Mac17,3 / 16 GiB from the adjacent corpus report, same developer Mac.

method.dataset: One synthetic 100-byte file metadata record and one declaration per path; no corresponding filesystem files created.
method.query: NameOrder prefix for the final generated function name, limit16, 64KiB record budget; require exactly one examined raw record and one result.
method.timer: Go testing.B.Loop excludes setup and performs no repeated setup for calibration.
method.rss: macOS /usr/bin/time -l maximum resident set size of compiled benchmark process; no compiler or extraction helper.
method.cache: No filesystem cache flush. Fresh private catalog at each size.
method.workload: Corpus measurements finished before these runs. Other ordinary development activity was not controlled.
method.catalog_bytes: Main database after construction before snapshot pinning; not peak database-plus-journal usage.
